runtime.title: Task Runtime
runtime.createHelp: A deterministic task for testing events, evidence, evaluation, and recovery. It is not the CTF role UI.
runtime.emptyHelp: Run one fact chain to see a proposal become a verifiable outcome.
runtime.emptyDetailHelp: This page reads a projection owned by the Go Runtime. React cannot change task facts or declare success.
runtime.jobHelp: The Fake Engine proposes, the Capability commits facts, and the Evaluator independently decides the outcome.
runtime.eventHelp: Every record is committed to SQLite before it reaches this page.
runtime.waitingEvidence: Waiting for the Capability to commit raw material.

settings.title: Settings
settings.defaultProviderDesc: Select your primary LLM provider and model for new conversations.
settings.relayDesc: Route all requests through a relay service
settings.relayHint: When enabled, all model requests use this relay (OpenAI-compatible format). Restart MilkSU after changing relay settings.
settings.relayActiveHint: Direct provider keys are not used while relay is active. Configure them as fallback.
settings.directKeysHint: API keys are stored in macOS Keychain and injected only when a local Agent process starts. Saved keys are never returned to the frontend.
settings.replaceKeyPlaceholder: Enter a new key to replace the stored key
settings.pendingSave: Will be written to macOS Keychain when saved
settings.pendingReplacement: Will replace the key stored in macOS Keychain
settings.pendingRemoval: Will be removed from macOS Keychain when saved

usage.tokenUsageDesc: Rough estimate based on message character count (~4 chars per token). Real token counts from provider API are not yet available.
usage.realTimeMetricsDesc: These fields require usage data from the provider API. They will populate once the bridge reports token usage events.
usage.configuredNote: Add API keys in the API Keys section.

about.storageDesc: All data is stored locally on your machine.
